svg.style: max-width: 682.391px; background-color: rgb(246, 247, 242); font-family: "Segoe UI", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
svg.title: AIB workbook architecture
svg.desc: The browser submits edits through the local HTTP server. The CLI can use local RPC or call the workbook service offline. The service coordinates workbook operations, conversion and transactional storage.
